notes: SFX driver $9B58 runs every 50 Hz raster IRQ ($8A32), only when $63==0 (in game) and writes $D418 = $4F (HP filter, vol 15) or 0 if sound off ($A2).
Filter: cutoff 11-bit = $50<<3 = 640, resonance 0, mode high-pass; routing $D417 bits0/1 = voice1/2 filtered (set by thrust/shield/gun).
Per-frame register dumps produced by emulating the driver: sounds_frames.json (tools/rules/sfx.py).
Voice 2 pulse width low byte is swept continuously by $9B50 (+/-5 per frame, bouncing between $1E and $DC).

explosion.trigger: $9C94 from $9EF5 (any explosion incl. reactor hit spark, ship death)

music.player: $2000-$2CAC (Rob Hubbard driver), data/tables $238F (freq table), $244F.. state, $2487 instruments (8 bytes), $2565/$2568 track pointers, $256B/$2592 pattern pointers, track lists $25B9/$2657/$26EF
music.play: $3000 (= JMP $2000), called once per raster IRQ (50 Hz) from $8A38; the player itself skips every 11th call
music.init: none: state at $2452-$2484 starts at 0 in mem_at_start.bin; player never re-inits (resumes where it left off)
music.enable: plays only when $63 != 0 (title/demo) and $A2 == 0; otherwise $2C96 silences voices once ($246F)
